goal: Fatal Process Crash on Startup (0xe0434352 / PSInvalidOperationException) Root Cause Analysis & Elimination
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Diagnose startup crash from Windows Event Logs and process lifecycle traces.
2. Identify root cause: PowerShell ScriptBlock execution on CLR ThreadPool threads lacking Runspace in TLS.
3. Replace asynchronous stream redirection (Add_ErrorDataReceived, Add_OutputDataReceived) with isolated file-based rclone logging (--log-file, --use-json-log).
4. Implement safe UI thread progress consumption via Update-CloudTransferJobProgressFromLog.
5. Verify unit tests (Test-CloudTransferManager.ps1, Test-PostRestartDropDeduplication.ps1, Test-StartupAutoMountTimer.ps1, Test-TransferRecoveryAndProgression.ps1) pass with exit code 0.
6. Rebuild NSCloudDrive.exe native launcher and verify clean desktop startup without silent closing.
7. Enforce strict 1:1 granular commit and push protocol for every file modification.

decisions.decision: Replace asynchronous process stream delegates (Add_ErrorDataReceived / Add_OutputDataReceived) with per-job file logging (--log-file) in Start-CloudTransfer.
decisions.rationale: CLR ThreadPool threads executing .NET AsyncStreamReader callbacks lack a PowerShell Runspace in TLS, throwing PSInvalidOperationException (0xe0434352) and immediately terminating the hosted WPF application.

decisions.decision: Implement Update-CloudTransferJobProgressFromLog using safe file sharing (FileShare.ReadWrite) and byte offsets.
decisions.rationale: Safely parses JSON stats on the PowerShell UI/engine thread without threadpool cross-talk, pipe deadlocks, or UI freezing.

reviewFindings.finding: Audited CloudTransferManager.ps1 diff. Verified complete removal of ThreadPool delegates, zero raw non-ASCII unicode characters, strict mode compliance, and non-blocking file reads using FileShare.ReadWrite.

securityFindings.finding: Verified that transfer log paths reside strictly in LocalAppData and sanitized diagnostic messages continue to redact auth tokens, client secrets, and sensitive credentials.
